fns.desc: eap_mschapv2_failure_txt's C= field parser computes hex_len = os_strchr(pos,' ') - (char *)pos with no NULL check on os_strchr's result; a rogue-AP-crafted EAP-MSCHAPv2 failure message whose C=<hex> field is the last token with no trailing space makes os_strchr return NULL, causing pointer-arithmetic UB (subtracting from a NULL pointer). Low real-world severity since the resulting garbage hex_len almost never equals PASSWD_CHANGE_CHAL_LEN*2, so it falls through to the 'invalid failure challenge len' log path, but it is genuine UB on attacker-controlled wire data.
